thread:
arjun: Pushed NF4/FP4 canary to eu-svc-pool at 06:18. Seeing ~30-40% drop in throughput and a spike in KV evictions. GPU util normal but token/sec down.

jess: Was this the selector v2.8 + new batching timeout tweak? commit 8f3b2c1?

arjun: yep. selector v2.8 + adaptive batching (timeout lowered). perf summary from the run:
```
kernel_time_ms: 18.4 (baseline 12.9)
kv_evictions: 1123 (baseline 350)
batch_fill_rate: 0.62 (baseline 0.87)
avg_tokens_per_batch: 14 (baseline 20)
```

perf-bot: ALERT: throughput -36%, p99 latency +280ms, kv evictions +220%. See /perf/alerts/2122109876

maya: sounds like packing/layout change caused selector to prefer fallback kernels. That can increase kernel_time and change allocation patterns.

tom: selector logs show many kernel_choice=fallback_int8_sim for seq lengths 256-512. Those fallbacks are slower for FP4 microkernels.

elena: can we confirm packed_size estimates? If estimate jumped due to quant packing, comparator function might mis-classify.

arjun: confirmed: packed_size_estimate now reports larger stride for certain layers after quant packing tweak.

jess: quick mitigation: revert packing-estimate logic to legacy v1 for NF4/FP4 in selector. I'll open a PR.

perf-bot: Proposed experiments: A) revert selector to v2.7 + old batching; B) selector v2.8 + revert packing-estimate only. 3-hour runs each.

arjun: also propose canary-only batching change: increase max wait to 8ms for short sequences to improve fill_rate.

maya: tradeoff ok — small p50 penalty but should reduce micro-batch fragmentation and KV churn.

tom: I'll bisect commits 7f1a..8f3b to find exact change to packing-estimate. Adding kv_alloc histogram and kv_evict_reason tracepoint.

jess: PR opened: https://git/redwood/selector/pull/458 (revert packing-estimate delta for nf4). CI passing.

arjun: launched two canaries: (1) selector revert + batching wait=8ms, (2) baseline selector v2.7. Posting perf links when done.

perf-bot: Added tracepoint kv_evict_reason to correlates evictions with kernel_choice.

maya: also adding calibration sweep to matrix — small calibration shifts change tensor distribution and can flip kernel thresholds.

elena: Aim: restore throughput to >=95% baseline and evictions <=400. Next: one-pager on how packing estimates affect kernel selection and runbook for rollouts.

tom: bisect progress: suspect change in packed_size_estimate at selector/pack.cc: line ~142. Will confirm.

jess: if canary looks green in 1 hour I'll merge the revert and start gradual rollout. :thumbsup:

arjun: logs uploaded: /perf/runs/2122109876/canary-diff. Marking follow-ups: jess(PR merge), tom(bisect), maya(calib sweep), arjun(canary retests). Deadline EOD tomorrow.

perf-bot: Actions recorded.
